title: House of Pilate and Salinas
text: Our visit to the Casa de Pilatos was sensational! Our guide Carmen is very informed, attentive to the group and respectful at all times. I recommend this visit! The visit to the Salinas house is also worth it
author: victorhgq

title: Excellent
text:
Clara is a very knowledgeable historical guide who speaks German very well and who takes everything into account and gives individual tours! 
Thank you very much!!
author: 40clarissav

title: A lovely, interesting visit of the house within the juderia. Fantastic story of key roles of women and men who build it
text: A unique house with lively stories of Catarina and her sons in the making the house a unique expression of Sevilla. Beautiful and well worth visiting with this experienced guide who made it alive.
author: Sightseer17120623621

title: Perfect visit that should never end :)
text:
Cette visite privée du centre de Séville avec Clara fut absolument charmante. Clara speaks a great english and she knows Sevilla better than anyone else. 
Clara is someone you won't forget :)
author: Gjom
